title: What If Every Seabird Vanished? Coral Reefs Would Feel It First

scenes.text: What if every seabird vanished? Coral reefs would feel it first.
Seabirds feed at sea and rest on islands, where their droppings pour nitrogen onto the land.
That nitrogen washes into the sea. One scientist estimates fifteen to fifty percent of the nitrogen in corals comes from it.
A study of twelve Chagos islands found about fifty percent more fish on reefs near bird-rich islands.
Where invasive rats had eaten the birds, seabird numbers were roughly seven hundred sixty times lower.
Fewer birds, fewer fish. Lose every seabird, and reefs lose their fertilizer.
